numbering: Episodes numbered 1-25 in broadcast order (single season, as on Wikipedia and animefillerlist).

arcs.name: The Black Swordsman
arcs.summary: A grim mercenary with a giant sword arrives in a town ruled by a monstrous lord.
events: Guts kills the corrupt Baron and takes his strange egg-shaped stone, a Behelit.
The episode ends by flashing back to how Guts's past began.

arcs.name: Band of the Hawk
arcs.summary: Years earlier, Guts is a lone sell-sword until the charismatic Griffith takes notice of him.
events: Griffith defeats Guts in a duel and claims him for the Band of the Hawk.
Guts rises to become one of the band's commanders.
Guts and Griffith barely survive the immortal warrior Zodd, who warns Guts about Griffith's fate.

arcs.name: Court Intrigue
arcs.summary: Griffith's rise at Midland's court makes enemies among the nobility.
events: Griffith becomes close to Princess Charlotte.
Griffith survives an assassination attempt.
Guts kills the scheming Julius and also a young boy who witnessed it.

arcs.name: Casca and the Battlefield
arcs.summary: Guts and Casca are separated from the band during a battle and must survive together.
events: Casca explains why she follows Griffith.
Guts holds off around a hundred enemy soldiers to cover Casca's escape.

arcs.name: Doldrey
arcs.summary: The Hawks are ordered to capture the fortress of Doldrey, the key to ending the Hundred Years' War.
events: Casca takes the fortress while Griffith and Guts beat the enemy commanders.
The victory ends the war.
The Queen plots to poison Griffith.

arcs.name: Departure and Downfall
arcs.summary: At the height of the Hawks' success, Guts decides to leave and find his own dream.
events: Griffith burns the conspirators alive.
Guts beats Griffith in a duel to leave the band.
Griffith sleeps with Princess Charlotte and is imprisoned and tortured.

arcs.name: Rescue of Griffith
arcs.summary: A year later, the Hawks are outlaws, and Guts returns to help free Griffith.
events: Guts rejoins the Hawks and grows close to Casca.
The band finds Griffith crippled and unable to speak after a year of torture.

arcs.name: The Eclipse
arcs.summary: Griffith's Behelit activates during the escape, and the Hawks are pulled into another world.
events: The God Hand offer Griffith a place among them.
Griffith sacrifices the Band of the Hawk and is reborn as Femto.
Guts loses an eye and an arm, and the series ends at that moment of despair.

filler.note: No filler; episode 1 rearranges and alters the Black Swordsman opening, so it is listed as mixed.
